user.title: Connect powermesh.de
user.description: Give consent on powermesh.de and create a personal MQTT access. Enter the broker settings shown there. Your existing local MQTT setup is not changed.

entities.title: Select entities

data_description.upload_interval: How often new readings are sent to powermesh.de.

reauth_confirm.title: New MQTT access
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your new personal access. Buffered readings are not automatically transferred to a new access.

smoothing.title: Smoothing per entity
smoothing.description: Choose per entity how values are smoothed before sending, similar to the Home Assistant filter helper. "Mean" sends the time-weighted average of each window, "At most one value" sends the first value of each window and drops the rest. Fewer values are transferred with longer windows. Default: mean over 1 minute.

error.invalid_connection: Enter a hostname, valid TLS port and complete personal MQTT credentials.
error.invalid_key_format: This is not a powermesh.de API key (bte_…).
error.consent_required: Consent to the transfer is missing on powermesh.de, or the key lacks the write scope.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
error.incompatible: Not supported (unit, device or state class): {invalid}
error.api_incompatible: The server version is not compatible with this version of the integration.
error.update_required: Please update the integration (HACS) to connect to this server.

buffer_generation_changed.title: Powermesh Energie: pending readings need attention
buffer_generation_changed.description: Buffered readings cannot be sent with the current access or were rejected. They have not been discarded. Check the status and preserve any needed local data before explicitly removing and recreating the entry. Removing the entry deletes its local buffer.

consent_required.title: powermesh.de: consent required
consent_required.description: powermesh.de refuses to store readings. Check consent and your personal MQTT access at {url}. Pending readings stay local; reload the integration after resolving the problem.

update_required.title: Powermesh Energie: update required
update_required.description: The server no longer accepts version {installed} of the integration. Readings are kept locally. Update the integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant.

api_incompatible.title: Powermesh Energie: incompatible server
api_incompatible.description: Version {installed} of the integration does not support the server version ({server}). Readings are kept locally. Check for an integration update in HACS.

update_available.title: Powermesh Energie: update available
update_available.description: Version {latest} of the integration is available (installed: {installed}). Update it in HACS.
